The '''Concord Dawn system''' was located within the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Contained within the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> The [[Star/Legends|star]] system, along with the surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sector]], came under the control of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] following their expansive conquest of the sector during their [[Time/Legends|time]] as [[Mandalorian Crusaders]].<ref name="TEA" /> The one-time [[Journeyman Protector/Legends|Journeyman Protector]] and ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], [[Cort Davin]], [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from the Concord Dawn system during the twilight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>
